snippet.title: Doom III Launch Trailer (a Doom II Mod)
snippet.description:
Doom III is a mod for Doom II.
It runs on the UzDoom and GzDoom engine, and if you own the new Doom + Doom II on steam you can use it's Doom2.Wad to run this mod with GzDoom.
both GzDoom as well as the Doom III mod can be downloaded for free.

Updated version 1.1a available: https://www.moddb.com/mods/doom-3-doom-ii-mod/downloads/doom-iii-doom-ii-mod-v11a
Update: Several maps has had some rework, freelook and crosshair play has been improved, new hints added to a hidden game mode which noone seem to yet have found, as well as some new sounds and textures. lots of fixes, tweaks and quality of life improvements.

Released on Doom II's 30th Anniversary.

Great thanks to the entire Doom Modding Community, this Mod would not have been possible without you.

Doom III Website: https://camaxide.wixsite.com/doom3
ModDB for Download: https://www.moddb.com/mods/doom-3-doom-ii-mod
D3 Discord: https://discord.gg/chfWWbJgHb
Ko-Fi Page: https://ko-fi.com/camaxide
Camaxides Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@camaxide

Thanks to Thomas Silver for making the trailer:  @thomassilver2529
